name: Unstoppable
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dex 15+, Str 13+, Speed 40 ft.

Benefit: Whenever you would fail a saving throw against an effect (spell, poison, special ability, etc) that would specifically hinder your movement, you gain a +2 bonus to the saving throw. Additionally, you may roll two dice and accept the better of the rolls.

Special: You may utilize this feat only if you are wearing light or no armor.
